item.text: The safest coordination boundary is to drain queued offer events before the switch and switch customer and notifier together. That prevents pre-change implied-consent events from being delivered after the rule change and avoids any mixed customer/notifier traffic window; the event shape remains additive-compatible for rollback and old queued data. I’m applying that rollout contract and tightening the customer tests around the exact event payload and explicit-consent predicate.
